Beyond the sound, ambient edge lighting sets a soft glow around the speaker that shifts with what's happening—powering on, pairing, running low on battery. Pick a light theme that fits your mood and let it ride. And with up to 10 hours of playtime plus an extra 2 with Playtime Boost, this portable Bluetooth speaker keeps the soundtrack going well past sundown. Clumsy moment at the pool? No stress. IP68 waterproof and dustproof protection plus a drop-proof build means this outdoor waterproof speaker is genuinely built for real life—not just the careful version of it. Want to fill more space with sound? Bump two Go 5 speakers together and AirTouch instantly links them into true stereo. Or connect additional Auracast-enabled speakers wirelessly when the moment calls for something bigger. It's big sound—all there for the grabbing and going.

title: BassBloom ROAR 3 Portable Bluetooth Speaker,IPX6 Waterproof,20W
description: Portable Design & Dual EQ Modes: This Bluetooth wireless speaker features a compact body and a handy carry strap, so you can place it just about anywhere. Weighing only 480g, it won’t weigh you down—but it delivers big on sound quality. Equipped with two EQ modes, you can choose between crisp, clear vocals or enhanced, punchy bass. One speaker. Both options. You’re covered. Exclusive JIKE Bass Enhancement Algorithm: The BassBloom portable Bluetooth speaker features our proprietary technology that delivers rich, detailed bass even at lower volumes. Powered by a 20W driver and dual passive radiators (top and bottom), it significantly enhances low-end performance—boosting bass impact by 80% and peak power to 30W. Perfect for desktop use at home or outdoor adventures like camping, hiking, beach days, or by the pool, it offers unmatched portability without compromising on premium sound quality. LED Power Display: This Bluetooth speaker features a clear percentage display—no more guessing. Powered by a large battery and equipped with low-power, stable Bluetooth 5.4 technology, it delivers up to 24 hours of playtime (tested at 50% volume, lights off). Enjoy a full day of music, worry-free! IPX6 Waterproof Protection: This waterproof Bluetooth speaker is rigorously tested to withstand powerful water jets from spills, pool splashes, or rain—and is even rinseable under a faucet. Take your music anywhere without worry. Whether it’s an accidental spill indoors or unpredictable weather outdoors, enjoy endless music, worry-free. (Note: Not intended for submersion in water or other liquids.) TWS Pairing & RGB Lighting: With just one tap, wirelessly pair two speakers to enjoy true left-right stereo—delivering a cinematic soundstage wherever you are. The RGB lights on the portable speaker bring any room, beach, or campsite to life, turning it into a vibrant music light show. It’s a fun, unexpected gift that’s sure to impress.
